en.title: Pairs of Strings with the Same Letter Set
en.description:
Two strings are similar if they contain the same set of letters; how many times each letter occurs does not matter. Identical strings at different indices can still form a pair, and (i,j) and (j,i) are counted only once.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of lowercase strings. 1≤n≤100000, total length ≤10^6. The original text does not exclude empty strings; this site's protocol supports an empty line representing an empty string.
hints: Represent each letter set as a 26-bit mask, and for each string add the number of earlier strings with the same mask.
